A.name: Mayor Jared Gray
A.basis: calls the meeting to order at 3:06, recognizes speakers, and records the adjournment motion (moved by Wood, seconded by Whiting); addressed as 'Mayor'

C.name: Councilmember Brett Wright
C.basis: in his '5th budget season,' recalls funding two more deputies than Chief McDowell asked for and praises the engineer's proactive planning; Mayor cues 'Brett had a comment'

D.name: David (City Engineer)
D.basis: delivers the entire FY27 transportation / 5-year capital plan presentation, says it's his 'first time with the budget cycle,' addressed as 'David'

E.name: Councilmember Melissa Clark
E.basis: raises e-bikes/community-policing (chief answers 'Councilmember Clark'), gives the 55/45 tax and master-offense-list / justice-court remarks

F.name: Chief Deputy Eric Knutson
F.basis: delivers the Sheriff's Office staffing-request presentation ('We are your police department'); addressed as 'Eric' and 'Chief,' referenced as Knutson

G.name: Mr. Reeves (City Administrator)
G.basis: frames the 'revenue problem not expense problem,' explains truth-in-taxation timing and data-center agreements, defers 'how we get there' to the next meeting; refers to Kimberly in the third person

H.name: Councilmember Zac Huish
H.basis: backup-unit and animal-control questions, the 'almost 20 years' resident with flat city property taxes, and the Airport Road pathway question (Mayor: 'Councilmember Herish talked to me about right-of-way on Airport Road')

I.name: Councilmember Rich Wood
I.basis: asks the growth-vs-crime question, gives the 'public safety is an afterthought' speech, addressed as 'Rich' and 'Councilmember Wood'

J.name: Kimberly (Finance Director)
J.basis: introduces the transportation/capital-plan segment, recognizes finance staffer Chris Waldron, hands off to David, and has the personal hard stop at 5
